name: pixcell
description: Photonic device figures to verified parametric GDS programs via your coding agent. Your agent recreates a device image (paper figure or drawing) as a primitives-only parametric GDSFactory program; a deterministic visual verifier (IoU at calibrated absolute scale) gates the result; measure-only physics tools retarget it across foundry layer stacks. Skills bind the pipeline stages (extract, generate, optimize, explore, migrate, simulate, optimize-to-spec); 7 measure-only MCP servers expose the tool plane.
